title: AAR Circular Letter Summary – September 2026

## About AAR Circular Letters


Circular letter summaries are produced monthly by[Greenbrier Management Services Group](https://www.gbrx.com/services/management-services/) .


[Download GMS brochure:](https://www.gbrx.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/gms-brochure_single-pages_hires.pdf)


AAR circular letters provide information of general applicability to the railroad industry, including proposed and final rules, revisions, standards and recommended practices, and calls for comments. These summaries provide the main points of circular letters issued in the prior month, as well as important implementation deadlines.


For access to the complete circular letter, please go to[my.aar.org/circulars](https://my.aar.org/circulars) . Circular letters are a fee-based service provided by the AAR’s Transportation Technology Center Incorporated (TTCI). You may subscribe online atpublications@aar.com or call 719.584.0538.


### Implementation Circulars


**C-14841**


**Subject:** Replacement Canadian Price Master for July 1, 2026


**Summary:** This circular addresses an error in the July 2026 AAR Canadian Price Master DAT file where an incorrect Canadian car repair facility labor rate was used. It announces the release of a corrected replacement Canadian Price Master DAT file effective retroactively to July 1, 2026, and provides instructions for counter billing and adjustments related to the error.


**Date:** 09-17-2026


**Effective Date:** 07-01-2026


**C-14842**


**Subject:** Informational Circular, Revision to the CRB Procedures Manual, “Mandatory Reject” Implementation Delay for Error Code ZA, ZB, ZC, & ZD


**Summary:** This AAR Circular Letter supplements and supersedes AAR Circular Letter C-14709 issued December 17, 2025. The AAR Car Repair Billing Committee has approved an initiative to indefinitely delay the conversion of Error Codes ZA, ZB, ZC, & ZD from “Information Only” into “Mandatory Reject” effective October 1, 2026, with these existing codes remaining “Information Only” for the time being.


**Date:** 09-21-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-21-2026


**C-14843**


**Subject:** Implementation of the new Online Adverse Audit Finding Report for Facilities audited by International Quality Consultants (IQC) and CR Quality Services (CRQS)


**Summary:** The AAR is implementing the Adverse Audit Finding Report (AAFR) online tool for M-1003 facilities audited by International Quality Consultants (IQC) and CR Quality Services (CRQS) Audit Agencies, replacing the paper and email communication processes. This tool will enhance transparency and efficiency in processing audit findings and is mandatory for IQC and CRQS M-1003 audits performed after November 1, 2026.


**Date:** 09-21-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-21-2026


**C-14844**


**Subject:** Implementation Circular: Modifications to MSRP F, Sensors, S-6101A Detector Validation Table / Acoustic Bearing Detectors.


**Summary:** This implementation circular advises of additions to the AAR’s MSRP Section F – Sensors / S-6101A: Detector Validation Table / Acoustic Bearing Detectors. The AAR’s Wheels, Axles, Bearings & Lubrication Committee (WABL) approved four new fault descriptors to be added to Section 2.1 Currently Validated ABD Software/Hardware/Fault Descriptor Matrix.


**Date:** 09-22-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-22-2026


**C-14847**


**Subject:** Implementation of Revisions to MSRP Section C-I, Specification M-947 Adhesive Backed Films for Marking Cars


**Summary:** This circular letter notifies the industry of revisions to Section C-I, Specification M-947 Adhesive Backed Films for Marking Cars – Performance-Based Requirements. Specification M-947 is now implemented and effective immediately, with modifications to be incorporated in the next issue of the Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices, Section C-I.


**Date:** 09-24-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-24-2026


**C-14850**


**Subject:** Implementation of revision to MSRP Section N, Specification M-951, Portable Bridge Plates for Multi-Level Auto Rack Cars


**Summary:** The Specially Equipped Freight Car Committee is implementing revisions to Specification M-951, Appendix B, Offset from Center Portable Bridge Plates – Requirements, Sections 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1. The implementation includes a 2-inch inboard offset bridge plate to allow the loading/unloading of narrow wheelbase vehicles, changes to stenciling on the bridge plate, and edits to Figure B-1 to incorporate these changes.


**Date:** 09-29-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-29-2026


**CPC-1450**


**Subject:** Implementation of the Revision to MSRP Section C Part III, M-1002, Specifications for Tank Cars, Appendix D, Paragraph 3.7.2.3.3.


**Summary:** Comments received from CPC-1447 have been addressed. This is the final action on the revision affecting Appendix D, Paragraph 3.7.2.3.3, which eliminates redundancy in M-1002 while allowing paragraph 3.6.2.2 in appendix D as the sole requirement for body bolster inspections correlating with Rule 88.B2.


**Date:** 09-21-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-21-2026


### Call for Comment


**C-14838**


**Subject:** Solicitation for Comments – Proposed New Standard for MSRP, Section M, Standard S-585 LOCOMOTIVE ALIGNMENT CONTROL


**Summary:** This circular letter solicits comments for a newly proposed standard addition to the AAR MSRP Section M, Standard: S-585 – LOCOMOTIVE ALIGNMENT CONTROL. The standard aims to minimize derailment risks associated with non-alignment control equipped locomotives moved in freight trains by defining terms, configuration of couplers and draft gear, and criteria for correct reporting into the Umler equipment information system.


**Date:** 09-10-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**C-14845**


**Subject:** Solicitation of Comments: Revisions to S-6101B Industry Data Validation: Wheel Impact Load Detector (WILD)


**Summary:** The Equipment Health Monitoring Committee (EHMC) is requesting comments on proposed revisions to S-6101B. The changes enhance test plan documentation requirements, provide greater flexibility within the validation test matrix, and establish a new conditional approval process for WILD systems advancing through the evaluation process.


**Date:** 09-24-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**C-14846**


**Subject:** Solicitation of Comments for Revisions to MSRP Section C-I, Standard S-252 Door Air Lines – Location of End Cocks


**Summary:** This circular letter solicits comments for revisions proposed to Section C-I, Standard S-252 Door Air Lines – Location of End Cocks. The AAR Equipment Engineering Committee worked with the RSI American Railcar Institute Committee to revise the standard to reflect modern construction methods and rename it to Auxiliary Air Train Line.


**Date:** 09-24-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**C-14848**


**Subject:** DRAFT S-9382.V1.1 Interoperable Asset Access Service, in support of AAR’s MSRP – Section K-I Railway Electronics Systems Architecture and Concepts of Operations


**Summary:** The Positive Train Control Interoperability Committee (PTCIC) is publishing DRAFT S-9382.V1.1 Interoperable Asset Access Service for review and comment. This document contains interoperable requirements for Asset Lookup and Asset Access, and includes behavior requirements for these messages.


**Date:** 09-25-2026


**Comment Period:** 8-day


**C-14849**


**Subject:** DRAFT S-9557.V2.0 Interoperable Train Control Radio Identification Allocation, in support of AAR’s MSRP – Section K-VI Railway Data Management and Communications


**Summary:** The Positive Train Control Interoperability Committee (PTCIC) is publishing DRAFT S-9557.V2.0 Interoperable Train Control Radio Identification Allocation for review and comment. This document describes the technical aspects of the radio ID as well as the table of current allocated IDs in the form of supplemental material.


**Date:** 09-28-2026


**Comment Period:** 8 Days


### Notice of Circulars


**C-14839**


**Subject:** Informational Circular, Canadian Car Repair Facility Labor Rate – Effective October 1, 2026


**Summary:** The Canadian Car Repair Billing Labor Rate calculation for October 1, 2026 is $268.20 CAD, a decrease of fourteen cents from the July 1 calculation. The change will be reflected in the October 1, 2026 release of the Canadian Price Master.


**Date:** 09-10-2026


**Effective Date:** 10-01-2026


**C-14840**


**Subject:** Annual Notification for Rule 107 Cost Factor Calculation Data Closing Date for Umler Original Cost Data – October 30, 2026


**Summary:** This AAR Circular Letter announces that an incoming snapshot of the ‘Umler Original Cost’ data field will be used for the annual Rule 107 Freight Car Cost Factor calculation effective January 1, 2027. Car owners have until the last business day of October 30, 2026, to update their Umler Original Cost data for inclusion in the snapshot.


**Date:** 09-16-2026


**Effective Date:** 09-16-2026

## Greenbrier’s Regulatory Services Group

Our core services include:


- DOT Compliance Assessments (Corporate and Plant)

- Federal Claims Mitigation Support (e.g., FRA and PHMSA)
- Regulatory Counsel and Policy Advocacy
- Railcar Repair Management (Design Review, Drawings, Engineering and AAR Approval Administration)
- Tank Car Reliability & Maintenance Programs (per 49 CFR Subpart F of Part 180)
